content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Bharathiar University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Bharathiar University, a well-known educational institution located in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. This is an excellent opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Temporary Guest Faculty. Various subjects are available, offering diverse opportunities for qualified individuals.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies available for Temporary Guest Faculty positions across different departments. Each post has one vacancy, ensuring focused recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for Bharathiar University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is "Walkin". Candidates need to attend an interview directly at the specified venue and date without prior online application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for these posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Temporary Guest Faculty positions is scheduled for 24 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they arrive well in advance of the scheduled time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Temporary Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Temporary Guest Faculty posts will receive a salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month. This is a contractual position with a fixed monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. or a Master's Degree with at least 55% marks in the relevant subject. NET/SLET/SET qualification is desirable for these faculty positions.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Bharathiar University Temporary Guest Faculty walk-in interview. This makes it accessible to all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Temporary Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: The selection process for Temporary Guest Faculty positions primarily involves an Interview, followed by Document Verification. Candidates must perform well in the interview to be considered.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, specifically at Bharathiar University. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact venue details within the university campus.
